regressions.title: Capture export polish can remove claims newly counted as covered by narration
regressions.evidence: The delta counts pre-polish step narration as coverage, suppressing the narrative's verify blockquotes. Later generate_polish_fields still rewrites capture narration; the restoration at :1331 applies only to photo mode. For example, its existing field gate permits 'Open the console and save the file before closing the window.' to become 'Open the console and save the file.' The new step gate checks text, not narration. The final coverage check merely restores the original narrative, which can now lack that claim too. Previously its verify blockquote survived polish. This introduces a path to losing a claim from all exports without a verify flag.

regressions.title: Narrative polish rejects valid coverage supplied by step narration
regressions.evidence: Generation now accepts placed_text as claim coverage, but validate_claim_coverage still examines only the narrative. When transcript claims remain intact under steps and the narrative paraphrases them, a valid narrative polish is rejected and polish_rejected_claim_coverage reports false missing claims. The final check must use the same coverage scope as generation, evaluated against final exported fields.
